description: TOO_MANY_SERVICES is a whole-frame answer (MCPWARP.md §2.6, §6A.6 G7): an app error op, no registered reply, no per-entry result. It answers the outstanding register (add_service beta), so beta becomes rejected with code TOO_MANY_SERVICES and the generic text, nothing is re-sent during a long tick, and the online group and the active alpha are unchanged. A conforming agent never sends more than 100 entries, so the edge's threshold is not reached here; the fixture pins the reaction to the answer, as 43_too_many_services_error_op does for one service.
